data.narrative:
Wardstone is a seed-stage Space & Aerospace company founded by Sebastian and Tobias Fischer that has raised $5M to date. The valuation universe comprises 5 public comps (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers including Starcloud, SpaceX, Rocket Lab, ICEYE, and Sierra Space.

Three standard triangulation methods were evaluated. Stage-Progression analysis was deemed inapplicable after a sanity check revealed the implied valuation of $212M would exceed 20x total raised—a threshold suggesting the base value proxy was unreliable. Peer-Median comparison could not proceed due to insufficient narrow peer density; while 14 same-sector peers exist, fewer than 3 datapoints matched same-stage or adjacent-stage filters with comparable valuation tiers. Public-Comp Anchoring, though feasible given the 27.4x median P/S multiple across the 5 public tickers, could not be applied because Wardstone's revenue was not disclosed—a typical constraint for private companies.

With all three standard methods inapplicable, this analysis cannot produce a triangulated valuation range. The core blockers are: absence of reliable comparable transaction data at seed stage in Space & Aerospace, lack of disclosed revenue, and a private peer set too sparse or heterogeneous to anchor multiples. Progression requires either (1) disclosed revenue or EBITDA, (2) seed-stage transaction data from the sector, or (3) founder/investor signaling on recent valuations from later-stage financing conversations.
